_source: Not a live capture: from Zoho Desk's documentation, https://desk.zoho.com/support/WebhookDocument.do ("Ticket Update Event", Sample Payload), read on 7 October 2026. An excerpt: the event envelope (prevState, payload, eventTime, eventType, orgId) as documented, and of prevState and payload only the fields that identify the ticket and its status, with Zoho's own example values; the documented sample's other fields (the contact, the assignee, custom fields and about fifty more) are left out. The documented sample is a change from On Hold to Open, so it carries no closure. A closed ticket has statusType Closed (Tickets API: statusType is OPEN, ONHOLD or CLOSED, written Open, On Hold and Closed in answers) and closedTime set; status is a name each department chooses (the documentation's own example has a status called Closed whose statusType is Open). The request carries Zoho's JWT in the X-ZDesk-JWT header ("Webhook Authentication" on the same page). Replace this file with a masked capture once the webhook is configured.
